*21. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI JIBON ROY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
at least 2,750 companies of the 5,651 listed
on the BSE were not available for trading
and have gone missing with around
Rs. 10,000 crore invested in these
companies by millions of investors;
(b) if so, how many of them have been
officially declared as 'disappeared' and the
total amount of investors' money involved
therein; and
(c) what steps are being taken to ensure
that the listed companies do not play “Loot
and Scoot” game with investors' money?

the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to

Splitting of Air India
139.SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to split
or halve Air India; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
 Deployment of ground staff by private
airlines
140.SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact  that Government
propose to stop private airlines from
deploying their own ground staff for
customer service citing security
considerations;
(b) if so, whether this would adversely
affect the comparatively better service
provided by private airlines; and
(c) whether there have been any glaring
cases of violation of security by these private
airlines which necessitated this action since
they commenced operation about a decade
back?
 Subletting of parking contract at
Ahmedabad airport
141.SHRI RAJU PARMAR: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Airports Authority of India
(AAI) has awarded parking contract to a
private firm  at Ahmedabad airport;
(b) if so, what is the name of the
contractor to whom the contract was
awarded recently with the terms and
conditions of the contract;
(c) whether the contractor has sublet the
contract of parking to some other person
who is charging exorbitantly from car
owners; and
(d) if so, what are the details thereof?
 Disruption of Alliance Air's schedule
142.SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Alliance Air's schedule has
been disrupted after a number of its aircraft
were seconded for the Prime Minister and
other VIPs;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and

 Removal of anomalies in time table of
IA and Alliance Air
146.SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to remove anomalies in time table of Indian
Airlines and Alliance Air flights as regards
connectivity from Delhi to different stations
of Assam like Jorhat, Dibrugarh, Silchar,
Tejpur and others via Guwahati; and
(b) if so, whether Cd7891 would be
extended upto Jorhat and Dibrugarh from
Guwahati?
 Discount on domestic fares by AI
147.SHRI SANTOSH BA GRODIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the recent move byAir India
to reduce the airfares on domestic flights is
only for a short time;
(b) if so, for what period this reduction
in airfare would be valid; and
(c) whether Air India would be able to
sustain the expenses incurred on domestic
flights keeping in view the heavy losses it
has already incurred in the past?
 Concessional airfares to holiday
travellers

 Expansion and modernisation of
Kanpur airport
143.PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the proposals that are
under consideration of the Government to
expand and modernise Kanpur airport;
(b) whether the facilities at the airport
are likely to be provided to facilitate the
operation of daily flight services from
Kanpur-Delhi and vice versa; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
 Bilateral aviation agreements
144.SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have concluded a series of bilateral aviation
agreements with no major advantage to the
Indian side while foreign carriers have
walked away with substantial benefits; and
(b) if so, what are the details thereof?
